name: json_text
description: Serialize named inputs to compact JSON text for prompt interpolation.

data.description: Arbitrary named inputs of any type/shape. Every key is serialized independently; there is no fixed key set.

One string property per input key, named "<inputKey>Json", holding that value's JSON serialization (compact-safe, sorted keys). A value that cannot be JSON-serialized falls back to the JSON serialization of its str() form instead of failing the task.
